description: Match a supplier invoice to its purchase order and goods receipt before it is paid (accounts payable three-way match). Send the PO lines (item, quantity, unit price), the receipt lines (item, quantity received) and the invoice lines (item, quantity billed, unit price), with optional quantity and price tolerances in percent. Get back, per item, whether it matches, and every exception: billed more than received, received more than ordered, price above or below the PO, billed but not on the PO, billed but not received; the money at stake per item; and the invoice total that matches. Answer fields: ok, verdict, result, rule, does_not, sources, observation, signature, verify. Errors: ok false with the reason (bad input, too large, hourly limit). Free. No model, no network, nothing you send is stored by the tool, and every answer is signed with LLPRO's key (check it at https://llpro.ai/three-way-match). Labels are your own text: emails, web addresses and long digit runs are refused. Not legal, tax or financial advice.
